units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:1:15">Y. Snh. X, 27ᵈ</cite> bot., a. fr. <he>כמה דת מר</he> (= <he>דתימר כמה</he>) as thou sayest, i.e. as we read in Scriptures &c.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:9:3">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 42ᵃ</cite> top <he>הדא דת מר וכ׳</he> (interch. with <he>הדא דאת אמר</he> = <he>הדא דתימא</he>) that which thou sayest (hast recited), applies only &c.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:7:2">Y. Snh. X, 29ᵈ</cite> top <he>על דעתך דת מר</he> according to thy opinion who sayest; a. fr.
